R1-2.may_retain: Original selected-panel results under their own denominators.
R1-2.may_add_after_author_review: Full source scoring, matched denominator contrast, known-reference and executed route estimates.
R1-2.must_not_claim: End-to-end diagnostic performance, population predictive values, or a historical downstream cascade.
R1-2.essential_for_broader_claim: Reference-complete representative population and executed route-specific follow-up.

R2-general.may_retain: Actual checkpoint-specific direct loss and published specialist scope.
R2-general.may_add_after_author_review: Bounded mapped Other results, individual class dispositions and explicit unknowns.
R2-general.must_not_claim: One validated all-class Other model, clinical LAE/LQTS validation, or original-head provenance for new fits.
R2-general.essential_for_broader_claim: Compatible reference controls, adequate positive support and validated frozen outputs for excluded classes.

R2-3f.may_retain: Ten candidate proxies and runtime concatenation verified on the pinned reconstructed scorer.
R2-3f.may_add_after_author_review: Executable input contract, observed widths, matched head ablation and remaining replay differences.
R2-3f.must_not_claim: Byte-identical historic replay, verified original loader, universally beneficial or clinically validated features.
R2-3f.essential_for_broader_claim: Original loader and numerical provenance for historical equivalence; complete backbone study only for a backbone-wide causal claim.

R2-4k.may_retain: Native threshold sets and fallback are ordinary model outputs, not clinical quarantine.
R2-4k.may_add_after_author_review: Separate post-study abstention study, with eligible and conditional denominators distinguished.
R2-4k.must_not_claim: Historic operational quarantine rate, clinical effectiveness, a second stage or human review.
R2-4k.essential_for_broader_claim: Historical ledger for historical attribution; independently verified clinical pathway and outcomes for clinical utility.
